verdict.rationale: LegalOS documents an employer-facing H-1B service. It runs a guided intake for company and role details, organizes employer and candidate materials in one workflow, and states it manages H-1B transfers and extensions. Enterprise hiring teams get attorney guidance and filing readiness. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration/lottery handling, any mention of LCA preparation or compliance (public access file, wage requirements), detail on which employer forms are handled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service

citations.quote: LegalOS helps organize employer and candidate materials in one structured workflow.
Share company, role, candidate, and timing details through a guided intake flow.
Give People, Operations, Finance, and hiring teams direct attorney guidance before the hire, then move cases toward filing readiness in 48–72 hours
